components_audited.evidence: target_start_timestamp strictly > feature_timestamp. Purging window dynamically applied.
All rolling windows use strictly backward rolling up to day T.
Walk-forward enforces dynamic purge = max(1, horizon) between train and test.

components_audited.potential_leak: Same-bar close execution and return mapping
components_audited.evidence: Mapped date T to backward ret_1d. Corrected to forward close-to-close and point-in-time open-to-open.
components_audited.repair: Separately evaluated Corrected Forward C2C and Corrected Next-Day O2O.

timing_audit.description: Phase 9.5 and 9.6 economic evaluation mapped prediction date T to backward ret_1d (Close_T - Close_{T-1}) / Close_{T-1} instead of forward return (Close_{T+1} - Close_T) / Close_T or next-day point-in-time open-to-open (Open_{T+2} - Open_{T+1}) / Open_{T+1}. This caused trade returns to evaluate the prior session's price move.
timing_audit.corrected_forward_c2c: date_to_ret = df_features['target_fwd_ret_1d'] mapped to prediction_timestamp (Forward Close-to-Close)
timing_audit.corrected_point_in_time_o2o: Signal after Day T close -> Order submitted -> Executed at Day T+1 Open -> Exited at Day T+2 Open
